name: CreativeMode
long_description:
In the past 9 months, more Minecraft mods were made with CreativeMode than in the game's previous 17 years combined. CreativeMode is making every player a creator.

Games like Minecraft, Fortnite, and Roblox started a revolution by allowing players to shape the games they love. CreativeMode is taking it to the next level by giving every player the power of a game studio at their fingertips. Players on CreativeMode create new experiences, play them with friends, and share their creations with the community. It’s a new way to play and create where imagination is the only limit.

CreativeMode’s founding team met as early engineers at Crusoe (soon to IPO) and studied CS+AI at Stanford, MIT, and CMU. The team is backed by top investors including YC and General Catalyst.

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio:
Wilson is co-founder and CEO of CreativeMode. 

Before CreativeMode, Wilson was a SWE working on building the AI cloud at Crusoe. Prior to that, he worked at Settle as a product engineer building new purchase order and AP tools for CPG brands. 

Wilson studied CS at MIT with focus on systems. He's originally from upstate South Carolina.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio:
Co-founder of CreativeMode.

Worked as a software engineer at Crusoe, studied CS at Stanford, with an undergrad focus on Systems and a coterm in the AI track.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio:
Jeffrey is co-founder and CTO of CreativeMode.

Previously, Jeffrey worked as a Software Engineer at Crusoe, where he helped run the Bitcoin mining team alongside Coleman and Wilson. 

He studied ECE at CMU where he received his BS and MS, and is originally from Hong Kong.
